description: This file defines an interface for accessing AWS SDK configuration defaults in PHP, specifying methods to retrieve various configuration options such as mode, regional endpoints, timeouts, and array representation.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface providing accessors for AWS SDK configuration options such as mode, regional endpoints, and timeouts.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the configuration mode, such as 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Indicates whether STS regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Indicates whether S3 US East 1 regional endpoints are enabled.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
